instruction: I want case-insensitive search in Vim by default. Please search online to find out how to enable case-insensitive searching in Vim and configure it permanently for my local Vim.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

parameters.command:
cat > eval_ignorecase__776de000.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if grep -q "set ignorecase" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null || grep -q "set ic" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Case-Insensitive Search Set!"
else
    echo "Ignorecase not configured"
fi
EOF
chmod +x eval_ignorecase__776de000.sh
